summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. Changes: track() gains show_speed=True (last param, documented, passed to TaskProgressColumn); TaskProgressColumn gains show_speed=False, a documented class docstring, a classmethod render_speed using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render() branch for unknown totals using finished_speed or speed; Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total (task_total is Optional[float]); CHANGELOG line added under Unreleased/Added; test_task_progress_column_speed added and the two ValueError assertions removed. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run because the instructions forbade running repository code; validation was by reading only.
